source_read: https://api.getspoonfed.com/262/benugo/menus/?c=1310 (Lunch), ?c=1309 (Breakfast), ?c=1315 (Cakes & Snacks), downloaded fresh 2026-10-08 (robots.txt: Crawl-delay 2, no Disallow; one request per page, 6 s apart); the pages are identical to the copies the script used apart from the per-request VIEWSTATE and verification tokens
notes: Calories-only chain, allergens link-only (guide link, no allergens.csv). My own regex parse of every product record (h4 product-name + energy-info line) matched the published kcal of all 79 items, including the renamed duplicates (Cut Fruit Box lunch 387 vs breakfast 393; Falafel & Hummus Wrap lunch bag 789 vs Moroccan 682); serving basis (per box / portion / slice / cake / none) and the vegetarian and pork/beef tags checked on the 12 sampled rows. The existing hold-back (Whole Pumpkin Almond & Pecan Streusel Loaf Cake printed '4612 Kcal per slice' for a 12-slice cake) is unchanged and still shows on the fresh page. The audit raised no flags. Note: the script docstring says robots Crawl-delay 2200; the live robots.txt says 2 (seconds).
